The game is pinned to Steam branch v2.6 and the UL archives are pinned by commit and SHA-256. Reinstall repairs the pinned release; import a newer revision of this egg and reinstall to update UL. Players must select the v2.6 Steam beta branch on their client.

Plan for at least a 40 GiB server disk allocation and 20 GiB of free headroom before reinstalling. Optional archive caching retains approximately 6.5 GiB after installation.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# 7DTD Undead Legacy Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/installers:debian'

set -Eeuo pipefail

STEAM_USER="${STEAM_USER:-}"
STEAM_PASS="${STEAM_PASS:-}"
STEAM_AUTH="${STEAM_AUTH:-}"
WINDOWS_INSTALL="${WINDOWS_INSTALL:-0}"
SRCDS_APPID="${SRCDS_APPID:-294420}"
SRCDS_BETAID="${SRCDS_BETAID:-v2.6}"
SRCDS_BETAPASS="${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}"
INSTALL_FLAGS="${INSTALL_FLAGS:-}"
UL_KEEP_CACHE="${UL_KEEP_CACHE:-0}"

on_install_error() {
    local status=$?
    echo "[ERROR] Installation stopped at line ${BASH_LINENO[0]} (exit ${status})."
    df -h /mnt/server /tmp 2>/dev/null || true
    exit "$status"
}
trap on_install_error ERR

if [[ -z "$STEAM_USER" ]] || [[ -z "$STEAM_PASS" ]]; then
    echo "Steam credentials are incomplete; using anonymous login."
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo "Using configured Steam user ${STEAM_USER}."
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD must be able to write the mounted server tree during installation.
chown -R root:root /mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd (pinned to v2.6 via SRCDS_BETAID)
steamcmd_args=(+@ShutdownOnFailedCommand 1 +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login "$STEAM_USER")
if [[ -n "$STEAM_PASS" ]]; then
    steamcmd_args+=("$STEAM_PASS")
fi
if [[ -n "$STEAM_AUTH" ]]; then
    steamcmd_args+=("$STEAM_AUTH")
fi
if [[ "$WINDOWS_INSTALL" == "1" ]]; then
    steamcmd_args+=(+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows)
fi
# Fresh SteamCMD clients can receive account information before their app-info
# cache is populated. Force a metadata refresh before resolving the beta depot.
steamcmd_args+=(+app_info_update 1 +app_update "$SRCDS_APPID")
if [[ -n "$SRCDS_BETAID" ]]; then
    steamcmd_args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
fi
if [[ -n "$SRCDS_BETAPASS" ]]; then
    steamcmd_args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
fi
if [[ -n "$INSTALL_FLAGS" ]]; then
    read -r -a extra_install_flags <<< "$INSTALL_FLAGS"
    steamcmd_args+=("${extra_install_flags[@]}")
fi
steamcmd_args+=(validate +quit)

install_game_with_steamcmd() {
    local steamcmd_status=1
    local steamcmd_attempt

    for steamcmd_attempt in 1 2; do
        echo "[7DTD] SteamCMD install attempt ${steamcmd_attempt}/2 for app ${SRCDS_APPID}, branch ${SRCDS_BETAID:-public}"
        if ./steamcmd.sh "${steamcmd_args[@]}"; then
            steamcmd_status=0
            break
        else
            steamcmd_status=$?
        fi
        if [[ "$steamcmd_attempt" == "1" ]]; then
            echo "[7DTD] SteamCMD exited ${steamcmd_status}; refreshing metadata and retrying once in 5 seconds"
            sleep 5
        fi
    done

    if [[ "$steamcmd_status" != "0" ]]; then
        echo "[ERROR] SteamCMD failed after two attempts (exit ${steamcmd_status})"
        return "$steamcmd_status"
    fi

    return 0
}

install_game_with_steamcmd

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Verify game install
if [[ ! -s /mnt/server/7DaysToDieServer.x86_64 ]]; then
    echo "[ERROR] 7DaysToDieServer.x86_64 not found after SteamCMD install."
    echo "[ERROR] Verify Steam beta branch '${SRCDS_BETAID}' is available and serves v2.6."
    exit 1
fi

echo "[7DTD] Installed from Steam branch: ${SRCDS_BETAID:-default}"
if [[ -f "/mnt/server/steamapps/appmanifest_${SRCDS_APPID}.acf" ]]; then
    steam_build_id=$(awk -F '"' '/"buildid"/ { print $4; exit }' "/mnt/server/steamapps/appmanifest_${SRCDS_APPID}.acf")
    echo "[7DTD] Steam build ID: ${steam_build_id:-unknown}"
fi

# UL archives are large; /tmp in the install container is often a small tmpfs.
# Download and extract on the server volume instead.
UL_WORK_DIR="/mnt/server/.ul-install"
UL_CACHE_DIR="/mnt/server/.ul-cache"
UL_STATE_DIR="/mnt/server/.ul-state"
UL_STAGE_DIR="${UL_WORK_DIR}/stage"
UL_RELEASE_BASE_ID="2.7.16-p1-499d7cf-p2-e890a4ea"
UL_APPLY_PATCH="${UL_APPLY_PATCH:-0}"

rm -rf "$UL_WORK_DIR"
mkdir -p "$UL_STAGE_DIR"

# Older revisions retained normalized payload trees without recording ownership.
# Recover that information once so the first managed reinstall can remove files
# that disappeared from the pinned release instead of merely overlaying them.
if [[ ! -f "$UL_STATE_DIR/owned-files.txt" ]]; then
    legacy_files_manifest="${UL_WORK_DIR}/legacy-owned-files.txt"
    legacy_dirs_manifest="${UL_WORK_DIR}/legacy-owned-dirs.txt"
    legacy_cache_found=0
    : > "$legacy_files_manifest"
    : > "$legacy_dirs_manifest"
    for legacy_cache in \
        "$UL_CACHE_DIR/part1.files" \
        "$UL_CACHE_DIR/part2.files" \
        "$UL_CACHE_DIR/patch.files"; do
        if [[ -d "$legacy_cache" ]]; then
            legacy_cache_found=1
            find "$legacy_cache" -mindepth 1 \( -type f -o -type l \) -printf '%P\n' >> "$legacy_files_manifest"
            find "$legacy_cache" -mindepth 1 -type d -printf '%P\n' >> "$legacy_dirs_manifest"
        fi
    done
    if [[ "$legacy_cache_found" == "1" ]]; then
        mkdir -p "$UL_STATE_DIR"
        LC_ALL=C sort -u "$legacy_files_manifest" -o "$UL_STATE_DIR/owned-files.txt"
        LC_ALL=C sort -u "$legacy_dirs_manifest" -o "$UL_STATE_DIR/owned-dirs.txt"
        echo "[Undead Legacy] Migrated ownership data from the legacy extracted cache"
    fi
fi

case "${UL_KEEP_CACHE,,}" in
    1|true|yes)
        UL_KEEP_CACHE=1
        UL_DOWNLOAD_DIR="${UL_CACHE_DIR}/${UL_RELEASE_ID}"
        mkdir -p "$UL_DOWNLOAD_DIR"
        # Cache entries are immutable and version-scoped; discard superseded releases.
        find "$UL_CACHE_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name "$UL_RELEASE_ID" -exec rm -rf -- {} +
        echo "[Undead Legacy] Verified archive cache enabled: ${UL_DOWNLOAD_DIR}"
        ;;
    0|false|no|"")
        UL_KEEP_CACHE=0
        UL_DOWNLOAD_DIR="${UL_WORK_DIR}/downloads"
        rm -rf "$UL_CACHE_DIR"
        mkdir -p "$UL_DOWNLOAD_DIR"
        echo "[Undead Legacy] Archive cache disabled (saves approximately 6.5 GiB after install)"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "[Undead Legacy] ERROR: UL_KEEP_CACHE must be 0 or 1"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

case "${UL_APPLY_PATCH,,}" in
    1|true|yes)
        UL_APPLY_PATCH=1
        UL_RELEASE_ID="${UL_RELEASE_BASE_ID}-patch-2.7.15-2.7.16"
        echo "[Undead Legacy] Optional 2.7.15-2.7.16 patch enabled"
        ;;
    0|false|no|"")
        UL_APPLY_PATCH=0
        UL_RELEASE_ID="${UL_RELEASE_BASE_ID}"
        echo "[Undead Legacy] Optional 2.7.15-2.7.16 patch disabled"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "[Undead Legacy] ERROR: UL_APPLY_PATCH must be 0 or 1"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo "[Undead Legacy] Using work directory: ${UL_WORK_DIR}"
df -h /mnt/server "$UL_WORK_DIR" /tmp 2>/dev/null || df -h /mnt/server || true

## Undead Legacy archive helpers

format_download_size() {
    local bytes="${1:-0}"

    awk -v bytes="$bytes" 'BEGIN {
        split("B KiB MiB GiB TiB", units, " ")
        value=bytes + 0
        unit=1
        while (value >= 1024 && unit < 5) {
            value /= 1024
            unit++
        }
        if (unit == 1) {
            printf "%.0f %s", value, units[unit]
        } else {
            printf "%.2f %s", value, units[unit]
        }
    }'
}

get_remote_size() {
    local url="$1"

    curl -fsSIL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 "$url" 2>/dev/null |
        awk 'tolower($1) == "content-length:" {
            value=$2
            gsub("\\r", "", value)
            if (value ~ /^[1-9][0-9]*$/) size=value
        }
        END { if (size != "") print size }'
}

download_with_progress() {
    local label="$1"
    local destination="$2"
    local total_bytes="$3"
    local download_pid
    local tick=0
    local downloaded_bytes
    local downloaded_display
    local total_display
    local percent

    shift 3
    "$@" &
    download_pid=$!

    # Pterodactyl renders newline-delimited installer output reliably, so emit
    # a SteamCMD-style status line every five seconds instead of redrawing one.
    while kill -0 "$download_pid" 2>/dev/null; do
        if (( tick % 5 == 0 )); then
            downloaded_bytes=$(stat -c%s "$destination" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
            downloaded_display=$(format_download_size "$downloaded_bytes")

            if [[ "$total_bytes" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
                total_display=$(format_download_size "$total_bytes")
                percent=$(awk -v current="$downloaded_bytes" -v total="$total_bytes" 'BEGIN { printf "%.2f", (current * 100) / total }')
                printf "[Download] %s: %s%% (%s / %s)\\n" "$label" "$percent" "$downloaded_display" "$total_display"
            else
                printf "[Download] %s: %s downloaded (total size unavailable)\\n" "$label" "$downloaded_display"
            fi
        fi
        sleep 1
        ((tick += 1))
    done

    wait "$download_pid"
}

extract_archive() {
    local archive="$1"
    local dest="$2"
    local header
    # Magic bytes — do not depend on GNU `file` (not in the installer image).
    header=$(od -An -tx1 -N4 "$archive" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' \n')

    if [[ "$archive" == *.zip ]] || [[ "$header" == 504b* ]]; then
        unzip -q "$archive" -d "$dest"
        return $?
    fi

    if [[ "$archive" == *.tar.gz ]] || [[ "$archive" == *.tgz ]] || [[ "$header" == 1f8b* ]]; then
        tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$dest"
        return $?
    fi

    if [[ "$archive" == *.tar ]]; then
        tar -xf "$archive" -C "$dest"
        return $?
    fi

    local ustar
    ustar=$(dd if="$archive" bs=1 skip=257 count=5 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [[ "$ustar" == ustar* ]]; then
        tar -xf "$archive" -C "$dest"
        return $?
    fi

    echo "[Undead Legacy] Unknown archive format (header: ${header:-none})"
    return 1
}

get_content_root() {
    local dir="$1"
    shopt -s nullglob dotglob
    local entries=("$dir"/*)
    shopt -u nullglob dotglob

    if [[ ${#entries[@]} -eq 1 ]] && [[ -d "${entries[0]}" ]]; then
        # A single top-level Mods/ directory is part of the payload for the
        # incremental update archive, not an extra wrapper directory.
        case "${entries[0]##*/}" in
            BepInEx|Mods|doorstop_libs|7DaysToDieServer_Data)
                echo "$dir"
                ;;
            *)
                echo "${entries[0]}"
                ;;
        esac
    else
        echo "$dir"
    fi
}

try_extract_nested_archive() {
    local dir="$1"
    shopt -s nullglob
    local archives=("$dir"/*.zip "$dir"/*.tar.gz "$dir"/*.tgz "$dir"/*.tar)
    shopt -u nullglob

    if [[ ${#archives[@]} -eq 1 ]] && [[ -f "${archives[0]}" ]]; then
        local inner_dest="${dir}/inner"
        mkdir -p "$inner_dest"
        if ! extract_archive "${archives[0]}" "$inner_dest"; then
            return 1
        fi
        rm -f "${archives[0]}"
        echo "$inner_dest"
        return 0
    fi

    echo "$dir"
}

install_ul_part() {
    local url="$1"
    local label="$2"
    local slug="$3"
    local expected_sha256="$4"
    local work="${UL_WORK_DIR}/${slug}"
    local archive="${UL_DOWNLOAD_DIR}/${slug}.archive"
    local partial="${archive}.partial"
    local actual_sha256
    local total_bytes

    rm -rf "$work"
    mkdir -p "$work/extract"

    if [[ -s "$archive" ]]; then
        actual_sha256=$(sha256sum "$archive" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
        if [[ "$actual_sha256" == "$expected_sha256" ]]; then
            echo "[Undead Legacy] Using verified cached archive for ${label}"
        else
            echo "[Undead Legacy] Cached ${label} checksum mismatch; downloading a clean copy"
            rm -f "$archive"
        fi
    fi

    if [[ ! -s "$archive" ]]; then
        rm -f "$partial"
        echo "[Undead Legacy] Downloading pinned ${label}"
        total_bytes=$(get_remote_size "$url" || true)
        if [[ -n "$total_bytes" ]]; then
            echo "[Undead Legacy] ${label} total size: $(format_download_size "$total_bytes")"
        else
            echo "[Undead Legacy] ${label} total size unavailable; reporting downloaded size"
        fi
        if ! download_with_progress "$label" "$partial" "$total_bytes" curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 --create-dirs "$url" -o "$partial"; then
            echo "[Undead Legacy] curl failed for ${label}; trying wget"
            download_with_progress "$label" "$partial" "$total_bytes" wget -q -O "$partial" "$url"
        fi
        actual_sha256=$(sha256sum "$partial" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
        if [[ "$actual_sha256" != "$expected_sha256" ]]; then
            echo "[Undead Legacy] ERROR: ${label} checksum mismatch"
            echo "[Undead Legacy] Expected ${expected_sha256}; received ${actual_sha256}"
            rm -f "$partial"
            exit 1
        fi
        mv "$partial" "$archive"
    fi

    echo "[Undead Legacy] Verified ${label}: ${expected_sha256}"
    echo "[Undead Legacy] Archive size: $(du -h "$archive" | cut -f1)"
    extract_archive "$archive" "$work/extract"

    local extracted_root
    extracted_root=$(try_extract_nested_archive "$work/extract")
    local content_root
    content_root=$(get_content_root "$extracted_root")
    cp -a "${content_root}/." "$UL_STAGE_DIR/"

    if [[ "$UL_KEEP_CACHE" != "1" ]]; then
        rm -f "$archive"
    fi
    rm -rf "$work"
    echo "[Undead Legacy] ${label} staged"
}

install_ul_part \
    "https://gitlab.com/subquakesgroup/UndeadLegacyExperimentalPart1/-/archive/499d7cf76b9372f291aed8543eedd7c196ddd387/UndeadLegacyExperimentalPart1-499d7cf76b9372f291aed8543eedd7c196ddd387.zip" \
    "Experimental Part 1 (2.7.16)" "part1" \
    "7749ef73aa953edd6b24ce3e13a98adef46100bf7e9aa6c0806f319b7287fb3b"
install_ul_part \
    "https://gitlab.com/subquakesgroup/UndeadLegacyExperimentalPart2/-/archive/e890a4ead20da776a0554f7b098f2e613ebaccc1/UndeadLegacyExperimentalPart2-e890a4ead20da776a0554f7b098f2e613ebaccc1.zip" \
    "Experimental Part 2 (2.7.16)" "part2" \
    "2881ea7bc9735c3cdfbff1edba7615d111f80e5bbbc0a402a904bc8e5df1f82d"
if [[ "$UL_APPLY_PATCH" == "1" ]]; then
    install_ul_part \
        "https://ul.subquake.com/dl?v=2.7.15-2.7.16" \
        "Patch 2.7.15-2.7.16" "patch" \
        "b86c7ca40b81fe3495a08d3e41a4c7300803fb82f4afa7ea18276009b5f09dcc"
fi

if [[ ! -f "$UL_STAGE_DIR/Mods/UndeadLegacy/ModInfo.xml" ]] || [[ ! -d "$UL_STAGE_DIR/BepInEx" ]]; then
    echo "[Undead Legacy] ERROR: staged payload is incomplete"
    exit 1
fi

new_files_manifest="${UL_WORK_DIR}/owned-files.txt"
new_dirs_manifest="${UL_WORK_DIR}/owned-dirs.txt"
find "$UL_STAGE_DIR" -mindepth 1 \( -type f -o -type l \) -printf '%P\n' | LC_ALL=C sort > "$new_files_manifest"
find "$UL_STAGE_DIR" -mindepth 1 -type d -printf '%P\n' | LC_ALL=C sort > "$new_dirs_manifest"

safe_owned_path() {
    local relative_path="$1"
    local resolved_parent

    if [[ -z "$relative_path" ]] || [[ "$relative_path" == /* ]] ||
       [[ "$relative_path" == ".." ]] || [[ "$relative_path" == ../* ]] ||
       [[ "$relative_path" == */../* ]] || [[ "$relative_path" == */.. ]]; then
        return 1
    fi

    resolved_parent=$(realpath -m -- "/mnt/server/$(dirname -- "$relative_path")")
    [[ "$resolved_parent" == "/mnt/server" || "$resolved_parent" == /mnt/server/* ]]
}

remove_previous_owned_files() {
    local relative_path target

    if [[ -f "$UL_STATE_DIR/owned-files.txt" ]]; then
        while IFS= read -r relative_path; do
            if ! safe_owned_path "$relative_path"; then
                echo "[Undead Legacy] ERROR: unsafe path in prior ownership manifest: ${relative_path}"
                exit 1
            fi
            target="/mnt/server/${relative_path}"
            if [[ -d "$target" && ! -L "$target" ]]; then
                echo "[Undead Legacy] Preserving user-created directory at former file path: ${relative_path}"
            else
                rm -f -- "$target"
            fi
        done < "$UL_STATE_DIR/owned-files.txt"
    fi

    if [[ -f "$UL_STATE_DIR/owned-dirs.txt" ]]; then
        while IFS= read -r relative_path; do
            if ! safe_owned_path "$relative_path"; then
                echo "[Undead Legacy] ERROR: unsafe path in prior ownership manifest: ${relative_path}"
                exit 1
            fi
            rmdir --ignore-fail-on-non-empty -- "/mnt/server/${relative_path}"
        done < <(tac "$UL_STATE_DIR/owned-dirs.txt")
    fi
}

echo "[Undead Legacy] Removing files owned by the previously installed UL release"
remove_previous_owned_files
echo "[Undead Legacy] Installing verified release ${UL_RELEASE_ID}"
cp -a "${UL_STAGE_DIR}/." /mnt/server/
rm -rf "$UL_STAGE_DIR"

if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/Mods/UndeadLegacy/ModInfo.xml ]] || [[ ! -d /mnt/server/BepInEx ]]; then
    echo "[Undead Legacy] ERROR: installed payload is incomplete"
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "$UL_STATE_DIR"
install -m 0644 "$new_files_manifest" "$UL_STATE_DIR/owned-files.txt"
install -m 0644 "$new_dirs_manifest" "$UL_STATE_DIR/owned-dirs.txt"
printf '%s\n' "$UL_RELEASE_ID" > "$UL_STATE_DIR/release"
echo "[Undead Legacy] Installed release: ${UL_RELEASE_ID}"

## Ensure Linux Doorstop is the version shipped with BepInEx 5.4.23.5.
# Some dedicated-server packages have included an older native Doorstop library,
# which prevents BepInEx from loading even when the managed DLLs are present.
BEPINEX_VERSION="5.4.23.5"
BEPINEX_LINUX_URL="https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/download/v${BEPINEX_VERSION}/BepInEx_linux_x64_${BEPINEX_VERSION}.zip"
DOORSTOP_PATH="/mnt/server/doorstop_libs/libdoorstop_x64.so"
DOORSTOP_SHA256="07ec6ee28c7d200c000ba9db6dfecec466a6ed449194a37decb719bf5321aee0"

current_doorstop_sha256=""
if [[ -f "$DOORSTOP_PATH" ]]; then
    current_doorstop_sha256=$(sha256sum "$DOORSTOP_PATH" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
fi

if [[ "$current_doorstop_sha256" == "$DOORSTOP_SHA256" ]]; then
    echo "[BepInEx] Linux Doorstop ${BEPINEX_VERSION} already installed"
else
    BEPINEX_WORK_DIR="${UL_WORK_DIR}/bepinex-linux-x64"
    BEPINEX_ARCHIVE="${BEPINEX_WORK_DIR}/bepinex.zip"
    rm -rf "$BEPINEX_WORK_DIR"
    mkdir -p "$BEPINEX_WORK_DIR/extract"

    echo "[BepInEx] Installing Linux Doorstop ${BEPINEX_VERSION}"
    if ! curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 "$BEPINEX_LINUX_URL" -o "$BEPINEX_ARCHIVE"; then
        echo "[BepInEx] Failed to download ${BEPINEX_LINUX_URL}"
        rm -rf "$BEPINEX_WORK_DIR"
        exit 1
    fi

    if ! unzip -q "$BEPINEX_ARCHIVE" libdoorstop.so -d "$BEPINEX_WORK_DIR/extract"; then
        echo "[BepInEx] Failed to extract libdoorstop.so"
        rm -rf "$BEPINEX_WORK_DIR"
        exit 1
    fi

    downloaded_doorstop_sha256=$(sha256sum "$BEPINEX_WORK_DIR/extract/libdoorstop.so" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
    if [[ "$downloaded_doorstop_sha256" != "$DOORSTOP_SHA256" ]]; then
        echo "[BepInEx] Doorstop checksum mismatch: ${downloaded_doorstop_sha256}"
        rm -rf "$BEPINEX_WORK_DIR"
        exit 1
    fi

    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$DOORSTOP_PATH")"
    install -m 0755 "$BEPINEX_WORK_DIR/extract/libdoorstop.so" "$DOORSTOP_PATH"
    rm -rf "$BEPINEX_WORK_DIR"
    echo "[BepInEx] Linux Doorstop ${BEPINEX_VERSION} installed as ${DOORSTOP_PATH}"
fi

## Verify Undead Legacy install
if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/Mods/UndeadLegacy/ModInfo.xml ]]; then
    echo "[Undead Legacy] ERROR: ModInfo.xml not found after install"
    exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -d /mnt/server/BepInEx ]]; then
    echo "[Undead Legacy] ERROR: BepInEx directory not found"
    exit 1
fi

echo "[Undead Legacy] Mod verification passed"

## Apply the minimum UL server configuration (https://ul.subquake.com/servers)
# Keep the custom underscore file across Steam/reinstall overlays. Seed it only
# once from Steam's default config on a fresh server.
SERVER_CONFIG="/mnt/server/_serverconfig.xml"
DEFAULT_SERVER_CONFIG="/mnt/server/serverconfig.xml"
if [[ ! -f "${SERVER_CONFIG}" ]] && [[ -f "${DEFAULT_SERVER_CONFIG}" ]]; then
    echo "[Undead Legacy] Creating persistent config: ${SERVER_CONFIG}"
    cp -a "${DEFAULT_SERVER_CONFIG}" "${SERVER_CONFIG}" || exit 1
fi

echo "[Undead Legacy] Configuring ${SERVER_CONFIG}"
if [[ -f "${SERVER_CONFIG}" ]]; then
    # Remove the optional settings block written by older revisions of this egg.
    awk '
        /<!-- Undead Legacy specific options -->/ { skipping=1; next }
        skipping && /<\/ServerSettings>/ { skipping=0 }
        !skipping { print }
    ' "${SERVER_CONFIG}" > "${SERVER_CONFIG}.ul" && mv "${SERVER_CONFIG}.ul" "${SERVER_CONFIG}"

    # UL requires EAC to be disabled. Match the property rather than replacing
    # an unrelated "true" value on the same line.
    sed -Ei '/name="EACEnabled"/ s/value="[^"]*"/value="false"/' "${SERVER_CONFIG}"
    if ! grep -Eq 'name="EACEnabled"[^>]*value="false"|value="false"[^>]*name="EACEnabled"' "${SERVER_CONFIG}"; then
        echo "[Undead Legacy] ERROR: could not verify EACEnabled=false in ${SERVER_CONFIG}"
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "[Undead Legacy] ERROR: neither ${SERVER_CONFIG} nor ${DEFAULT_SERVER_CONFIG} exists"
    exit 1
fi

## Mono config patch for Linux
MONO_CONFIG="/mnt/server/7DaysToDieServer_Data/MonoBleedingEdge/etc/mono/config"
if [[ -f "$MONO_CONFIG" ]]; then
    if grep -q 'libdl.so.2' "$MONO_CONFIG"; then
        echo "[Undead Legacy] mono config dllmap already present, skipping"
    else
        echo "[Undead Legacy] Adding dllmap to mono config"
        awk '
            /<\/configuration>/ && !done {
                print "\t<dllmap dll=\"dl\" target=\"libdl.so.2\"/>"
                done=1
            }
            { print }
        ' "$MONO_CONFIG" > "${MONO_CONFIG}.ul" && mv "${MONO_CONFIG}.ul" "$MONO_CONFIG"
    fi
else
    echo "[Undead Legacy] WARNING: mono config not found at ${MONO_CONFIG}"
fi

# Send important BepInEx levels to the process console and disable its separate
# disk listener. The launcher duplicates that process stream to
# logs/latest.log while leaving it visible to Pterodactyl.
BEPINEX_CONFIG="/mnt/server/BepInEx/config/BepInEx.cfg"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "${BEPINEX_CONFIG}")"
if [[ ! -f "${BEPINEX_CONFIG}" ]]; then
    install -m 0644 /dev/null "${BEPINEX_CONFIG}"
fi

set_bepinex_setting() {
    local section="$1"
    local key="$2"
    local value="$3"

    awk -v section="[${section}]" -v key="${key}" -v value="${value}" '
        BEGIN { in_section=0; saw_section=0; set_value=0 }
        /^\[/ {
            if (in_section && !set_value) {
                print key " = " value
                set_value=1
            }
            in_section=($0 == section)
            if (in_section) saw_section=1
        }
        in_section && $0 ~ "^[[:space:]]*" key "[[:space:]]*=" {
            if (!set_value) print key " = " value
            set_value=1
            next
        }
        { print }
        END {
            if (in_section && !set_value) print key " = " value
            if (!saw_section) {
                print ""
                print section
                print key " = " value
            }
        }
    ' "${BEPINEX_CONFIG}" > "${BEPINEX_CONFIG}.ul" && mv "${BEPINEX_CONFIG}.ul" "${BEPINEX_CONFIG}"
}

set_bepinex_setting "Logging.Console" "Enabled" "true" || exit 1
set_bepinex_setting "Logging.Console" "LogLevels" "Fatal, Error, Warning, Message" || exit 1
# BepInEx 5's reflected Mono CStreamWriter path crashes in Pterodactyl's TTY.
set_bepinex_setting "Logging.Console" "ForceBepInExTTYDriver" "true" || exit 1
set_bepinex_setting "Logging.Disk" "Enabled" "false" || exit 1
echo "[BepInEx] Important levels use the unified process log; separate disk logging disabled"

chmod +x /mnt/server/7DaysToDieServer.x86_64

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.ul-bin
rm -f /mnt/server/.ul-bin/file

# Launch with explicit, verified Doorstop state instead of depending on the
# supplied launcher's inherited preload state. Only the console client and
# loader monitor are asynchronous; Unity remains the foreground process.
cat > /mnt/server/.ul-bin/start-undead-legacy.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
server_dir="$(cd "${script_dir}/.." && pwd -P)"
cd "${server_dir}" || exit 1

# Begin from a clean bootstrap state before creating any helper processes.
unset LD_PRELOAD DOORSTOP_DISABLE DOORSTOP_INITIALIZED

log_dir="${server_dir}/logs"
unified_log="${log_dir}/latest.log"
if ! command -v tee >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[UL-LOADER] ERROR: tee is required for unified logging"
    exit 1
fi
mkdir -p "${log_dir}" || exit 1
: > "${unified_log}" || exit 1

# Unity's null graphics device and Mono fallback resolver emit thousands of
# known-benign startup lines on this headless server. Suppress only those exact
# families; all other launcher, BepInEx, Unity, warning, and error output stays.
filter_runtime_log() {
    local line suppressed=0 suppress_memory_statistics=0 startup_complete=0

    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "${line}" ]]; do
        if ((suppress_memory_statistics)); then
            case "${line}" in
                "Shutdown handler: cleanup."*)
                    suppress_memory_statistics=0
                    printf '%s\n' "${line}"
                    ;;
                *)
                    ((suppressed++))
                    ;;
            esac
            continue
        fi

        case "${line}" in
            *"StartGame done"*)
                startup_complete=1
                printf '%s\n' "${line}"
                ;;
            "[UnityMemory] Configuration Parameters - Can be set up in boot.config"*)
                ((suppressed++))
                ;;
            "    \"memorysetup-"*)
                ((suppressed++))
                ;;
            GamePref.*|GameStat.*)
                if ((startup_complete)); then
                    printf '%s\n' "${line}"
                else
                    ((suppressed++))
                fi
                ;;
            "Memory Statistics:"*)
                ((suppressed++))
                suppress_memory_statistics=1
                ;;
            *Fallback\ handler\ could\ not\ load\ library\ */data-0x*.so*)
                ((suppressed++))
                ;;
            "WARNING: Shader Unsupported:"*)
                ((suppressed++))
                ;;
            "WARNING: Shader Did you use #pragma only_renderers and omit this platform?"*)
                ((suppressed++))
                ;;
            "WARNING: Shader If subshaders removal was intentional, you may have forgotten turning Fallback off?"*)
                ((suppressed++))
                ;;
            ERROR:\ Shader\ *" shader is not supported on this GPU (none of subshaders/fallbacks are suitable)"*)
                ((suppressed++))
                ;;
            *)
                printf '%s\n' "${line}"
                ;;
        esac
    done

    if ((suppressed > 0)); then
        printf '[UL-LOADER] Suppressed %d known headless graphics/Mono noise lines\n' "${suppressed}"
    fi
}

exec > >(filter_runtime_log | tee -a "${unified_log}") 2>&1

echo "[UL-LOADER] Unified log: ${unified_log}"

game_path="${server_dir}/7DaysToDieServer.x86_64"
doorstop_path="${server_dir}/doorstop_libs/libdoorstop_x64.so"
preloader_path="${server_dir}/BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Preloader.dll"
doorstop_sha256="07ec6ee28c7d200c000ba9db6dfecec466a6ed449194a37decb719bf5321aee0"

for required_path in "${game_path}" "${doorstop_path}" "${preloader_path}"; do
    if [[ ! -r "${required_path}" ]]; then
        echo "[UL-LOADER] ERROR: required file is not readable: ${required_path}"
        exit 1
    fi
done

installed_doorstop_sha256="$(sha256sum "${doorstop_path}" | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
if [[ "${installed_doorstop_sha256}" != "${doorstop_sha256}" ]]; then
    echo "[UL-LOADER] ERROR: Doorstop checksum mismatch: ${installed_doorstop_sha256}"
    exit 1
fi

if ! doorstop_dependencies="$(ldd "${doorstop_path}" 2>&1)"; then
    echo "[UL-LOADER] ERROR: Doorstop dependency inspection failed"
    echo "${doorstop_dependencies}"
    exit 1
fi
if grep -Fq "not found" <<< "${doorstop_dependencies}"; then
    echo "[UL-LOADER] ERROR: Doorstop dependency check failed"
    echo "${doorstop_dependencies}"
    exit 1
fi

# Preserve panel stdin for the asynchronous telnet client. Bash otherwise
# supplies /dev/null to a background job when job control is unavailable.
exec 3<&0

# Telnet broadcasts the same timestamped 7DTD log lines that Unity already
# writes to stdout. Drop only those mirrored lines while retaining untimestamped
# command responses for the interactive Pterodactyl console.
filter_console_client_output() {
    local line

    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "${line}" ]]; do
        case "${line}" in
            20??-??-??T??:??:??\ *) ;;
            *) printf '%s\n' "${line}" ;;
        esac
    done
}

console_client() {
    local telnet_port="${TELNET_PORT:-8081}"
    local client_status

    echo "Checking on telnet connection"
    if [[ -z "${PASSWORD:-}" ]]; then
        until
            telnet -E 127.0.0.1 "${telnet_port}" 2>&1 | filter_console_client_output
            client_status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
            ((client_status == 0))
        do
            echo "Waiting for telnet connection..."
            sleep 5
        done
    else
        until
            rcon -t telnet -a "127.0.0.1:${telnet_port}" -p "${PASSWORD}" 2>&1 | filter_console_client_output
            client_status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
            ((client_status == 0))
        do
            echo "Waiting for telnet connection..."
            sleep 5
        done
    fi
}

server_pid=$$

fail_startup() {
    local reason="$1"

    echo "[UL-LOADER] ERROR: ${reason}"
    echo "[UL-LOADER] Terminating the server because mod readiness was not established"
    kill -TERM "${server_pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    sleep 10
    kill -KILL "${server_pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
}

wait_for_log_marker() {
    local marker="$1"
    local timeout_seconds="$2"
    local attempt

    for ((attempt=1; attempt<=timeout_seconds; attempt++)); do
        if grep -Fq "${marker}" "${unified_log}" 2>/dev/null; then
            return 0
        fi
        if ! kill -0 "${server_pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
            return 1
        fi
        sleep 1
    done

    return 1
}

verify_loader_and_readiness() {
    local attempt native_doorstop_mapped=0

    for attempt in {1..30}; do
        if [[ -r "/proc/${server_pid}/maps" ]] && grep -Fq "${doorstop_path}" "/proc/${server_pid}/maps"; then
            echo "[UL-LOADER] Native Doorstop is mapped in the server process"
            native_doorstop_mapped=1
            break
        fi
        if ! kill -0 "${server_pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
            break
        fi
        sleep 1
    done

    if [[ "${native_doorstop_mapped}" != "1" ]]; then
        fail_startup "Native Doorstop was not mapped in the server process"
        return 1
    fi

    if ! wait_for_log_marker "Chainloader startup complete" 180; then
        fail_startup "BepInEx did not report chainloader startup within 180 seconds"
        return 1
    fi
    echo "[UL-LOADER] BepInEx chainloader startup confirmed"

    if ! wait_for_log_marker "StartGame done" 1800; then
        fail_startup "7 Days to Die did not finish game startup within 1800 seconds"
        return 1
    fi

    echo "[UL-LOADER] Undead Legacy server ready"
}

console_client <&3 &
verify_loader_and_readiness &

# A child or previous bootstrap must not suppress this fresh dedicated-server
# process. Export only after starting the helpers so Doorstop is injected into
# Unity, not into telnet, grep, sleep, or the other diagnostic commands.
export DOORSTOP_ENABLED="1"
export DOORSTOP_IGNORE_DISABLED_ENV="1"
export DOORSTOP_TARGET_ASSEMBLY="${server_dir}/BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Preloader.dll"
export DOORSTOP_BOOT_CONFIG_OVERRIDE=""
export DOORSTOP_MONO_DLL_SEARCH_PATH_OVERRIDE=""
export DOORSTOP_MONO_DEBUG_ENABLED="0"
export DOORSTOP_MONO_DEBUG_ADDRESS="127.0.0.1:10000"
export DOORSTOP_MONO_DEBUG_SUSPEND="0"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${server_dir}/doorstop_libs${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}"
export LD_PRELOAD="${doorstop_path}"

echo "[UL-LOADER] Preflight passed; launching with ${doorstop_path}"

# The telnet client above is the only reader of Pterodactyl's console input.
exec ./7DaysToDieServer.x86_64 -quit -batchmode -noeac -nographics -dedicated "$@" </dev/null 3<&-
EOF
chmod +x /mnt/server/.ul-bin/start-undead-legacy.sh

rm -rf "$UL_WORK_DIR"

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"
